hook: How long should your clip be?

items.label: for a funny moment
items.say: Seven seconds for a funny moment. Hit the joke and get out.

items.label: for a hot take
items.say: Thirty seconds for a hot take. Enough to land the point.

items.label: for a full story
items.say: Sixty seconds for a full story. Only if every second earns it.

caption: Clip length cheat sheet ⏱️ Save it for your next edit. Rules of thumb, not laws.
